package.name: wheel_odometry
package.description: Mecanum-drive wheel odometry for the Lynxmotion A4WD3 Mecanum rover. Subscribes to raw per-wheel encoder counts (sensor_msgs/JointState, published by low_level_control_pkg's roboclaw_driver_node, which owns the actual RoboClaw hardware connection), applies mecanum forward kinematics, integrates a planar pose, and publishes nav_msgs/Odometry (+ TF) for use in sensor fusion.
